name: quickreview
//private: kept deliberately: this repo is an application, not an npm library — the flag blocks an accidental `npm publish` and nothing in the toolchain depends on its absence
description: QuickReview — a sovereign 24/7 AI code-review daemon: deterministic TypeScript core driving sticky LLM review sessions, with an operator TUI, Slack concierge, and a continuous learning loop your org owns end to end

repository.//: placeholder until the public repo exists (snapshot); update on first publish

scripts.//canary:pi: The offline pi canaries (tests/pi-canary/): the real pi SDK at the pinned version on pi-ai's faux provider, so no network and no cost. They also run inside `npm test`; this is the named entry point CI requires whenever the pi dependencies change (a bump is gated by it).
scripts.//lint: Deliberately NOT chained into `test` or `build`: scripts/dev-tui.sh blocks on the build before the TUI paints (ruling 5), and an ESLint pass there is seconds of blank terminal. CI runs it as its own step.
scripts.//typecheck:tests: tests/ is excluded from the BUILD (it emits nothing), so nothing type-checked it and ~40 latent errors accumulated — three of them tests that were asserting nothing, plus three more that read the real filesystem while claiming to drive an injected seam. Deliberately NOT chained into `build`: `scripts/dev-tui.sh` blocks on that build before the TUI paints (ruling 5), and a second full tsc pass there is 7s of blank terminal. `tests/fences-gate.test.ts` runs this as part of the suite instead, which is this repo's CI.

pi.//: pi and pi-ai are exact dependencies above (types for the extensions, and the VM boot's plain `npm ci` installs them beside the global CLI the image carries). This block is the mirror a bare checkout without config.toml reads: package and version must equal the dependencies, the lockfile, config.toml [pi], ansible group_vars and every Dockerfile ARG (tests/fences.test.ts [T12], tests/docker-daemon.test.ts). Subagents are pi's own first-party extension, shipped inside this package (examples/extensions/subagent) — no extra extension pin exists any more.
